title: 第八百七十六章 匕见第八百七十五章 图穷
lines: “白云观？你是说，岳父派人捎口信来，约我去城外白云观，还说有要事相商？”对于这么一个熟悉但又陌生的地名，公学中的张寿只觉得有些莫名其妙。
熟悉是因为白云观在后世也算是个挺有名的道家之地，当然这个名是好恶都有。而陌生是因为他到了京城之后还没到那地方去过，毕竟他闲着的时候实在是太少了。当然最重要的不是熟悉又或者陌生，而是……
赵国公府一大堆人，太夫人和九娘素来坚定站在他这一边，朱二也早就被他收拾得服服帖帖，而如今进门的朱莹那两位嫂子，也都对他相当亲切，和他最不对付的，也就是朱泾和朱廷芳父子了。朱泾一般不会特别指名要见他，而且见他可以在赵国公府，去什么白云观？
见张寿明显在踌躇，好像在质疑这件事是否有名堂，得到外间门房通报，于是亲自进来送口信的阿六就主动问道：“少爷，要不要我先去一趟赵国公府问问？”
要是平时，岳父约见，张寿怎也不至于推辞，可现在情况不同，他总觉得最近这些事情来势汹汹，却别有一番诡异。思来想去，他最终就点了点头。而少年去得快回来得也挺快，当张寿在九章堂上完又一堂课之后，阿六就再次出现在了他的面前。
“赵国公不在家里，大少奶奶告诉我，他派人送了口信回家，这两天有要事处理，暂时不回来。”说这话的时候，阿六脸上也有些狐疑，“我又去兵部衙门问过，说是今天上午早朝之后，赵国公先进了宫，后来就去林尚书府上吊唁，然后就出城去了，只捎了个告假的信。”
“然后我又去了一趟林府，因为吊唁的人不少，我就悄悄潜了进去，听到人议论赵国公来过，才有那么多人跟着来，全都是趋炎附势之辈。还有人说，赵国公今天坐车而不是骑马来的，带的随从很多。”
一口气说到这里，阿六见张寿翘起大拇指，似乎在夸奖自己的缜密，他却并没有因此高兴起来，反而更肃然了一些：“然后我去打听了赵国公一行人的行踪，有人看到他们一行人确实出城了。但是，赵国公在林府门前上车之后，在那条街上停留了一会儿才走的。”
张寿对朱泾虽说谈不上十分熟悉，但就阿六所言的这些，他却已经觉得，这明显迥异于朱泾那往日的作风。上马车却不走……岂不是因为那马车上还有别人？
所以，当他听到阿六说，人又特地进宫一趟，确证朱泾今日是从清宁宫出来方才去了林府吊唁，而后又去了赵国公府二度求证，打探到朱泾今日出门只带了八个随从，而区区八个人明显摆不出林府下人所言，那护卫前呼后拥的架势，他沉吟片刻，最终就立刻做出了决定。
“你跟我去一趟女学见莹莹，事有蹊跷，我要和她商量一下。”
因为女学中从上到下用的都是女子，张寿虽说来接过朱莹几回，但从来都是在大门口。此时他带着阿六匆匆赶到，让人通报一声后就在门前等，没想到不多时，却正好迎面遇上永平公主出来。
他和这位金枝玉叶也算是很早就相识了，但个性不合，所以也没有太多交集，此时不过侧身一让，拱手行礼而已。可永平公主并没有像平常那样，就和对普通官员一样微微颔首答礼，而是在他身边停留了下来：“张学士是来接朱监学的？”
虽说朱莹常常戏称自己是女学的督学御史，但实际上，皇帝当初让人刻了两方印，永平公主才是督学山长，朱莹则是监学巡查，可这名头张寿压根没有刻意去记，所以永平公主这么正儿八经地用朱监学三个字来指代朱莹，他不由得愣了一愣才反应过来。
而紧跟着，张寿就没有在乎这样一个称呼，而是沉声问道：“怎么，莹莹也不在？”
永平公主见张寿这短短一句话里，竟流露出几分焦躁的情绪，她不禁有些纳闷，随即就开口说道：“宫中太后娘娘派人来传见莹莹，因为人来得突然，又是在侧门接走的他，所以这正门的门房不知道，这才通报进去，我正好回宫，就告诉张学士你一声。”
“又是太后？”下意识地迸出这四个字，张寿也顾不得永平公主此时那微妙的表情，立时转身对阿六说道，“走，我们先去南城兵马司！”
意识到张寿这竟然是打算去见朱廷芳，永平公主一下子醒悟了过来，这恐怕有事情发生。她本想开口询问，可眼见张寿带着阿六走得飞快，她再转念一想，最终决定与其追上去讨没趣，还不如立刻回宫，去清宁宫太后那儿打探一下事情原委。
一个也字，一个又字，莫不是又出什么事了？
然而，张寿却根本没有寄希望于永平公主那边有什么样的收获。尤其是当他来到南城兵马司，最终却得知，朱廷芳在大约一个多时辰之前因事外出时，之前就已经隐隐怀疑的他终于彻底确定，自己这一趟白云观之行大概非去不可。
因为之前阿六捎来的白云观约见口信并未定下时间，因此他并没有立刻就出外城，而是先带着阿六赶回了张园一趟，取了一个匣子之后，主仆两人这才马不停蹄地出了西便门，往西直奔白云观。
之前张寿带阿六去女学时就已经黄昏，此时到了白云观，天色已经完全黑了。在张园匆匆塞了两块点心垫饥，又灌了一通水，此时张寿腹中并不饥饿，但心头那股怒火却相当炽烈。
此时的白云观静悄悄，高大的门楼巍峨矗立，仿佛犹如一座寻常的方外道观，可听到身后阿六提醒的声音，他却知道那只不过是个假象。因为耳力和目力一样敏锐的阿六正轻声告诉他，什么地方隐藏着人，什么地方有人窥伺，就如同他的另一双眼睛和耳朵。
虽说这地方就犹如龙潭虎穴一般，正等着人去自投罗网，但他还是义无反顾地大步走过门楼入内。随着一个年轻的知客道人犹如鬼魅一般现身，态度非常恭敬地深深行了一礼，他就沉声问道：“我家岳父呢？”
张寿没有问朱莹和朱廷芳是否也在这里，而那知客道人显然也没有问一答二的意思，人甚至一言不发，只是再次弯腰行礼，继而就转身在前头带路。
content_en:
"Baiyunguan? You mean, my father-in-law sent a message to ask me to go to Baiyunguan outside the city, and said he had something important to discuss?" For such a familiar but unfamiliar place name, Zhang Shou, who was in the public school, felt a little baffled.
I am familiar with it because Baiyun Temple was also a famous Taoist place in later generations. Of course, this name has both good and bad names. And it's unfamiliar because he hasn't been to that place since he arrived in the capital. After all, he has too little free time. Of course, the most important thing is not familiarity or unfamiliarity, but...
There are a lot of people in Duke Zhao's residence. Madam Tai and Jiu Niang have always been firmly on his side. Zhu Er has long been treated submissively by him. Now the two sisters-in-law Zhu Ying who came in are also very kind to him. The ones he has the least dealing with are Zhu Jing and Zhu Tingfang and his son. Zhu Jing usually wouldn't specifically name him to see him, and if he could see him, he could go to Zhao Guogong's Mansion. Why go to Baiyun Temple?
Seeing that Zhang Shou was obviously hesitant, as if he was questioning whether this matter was famous, Ah Liu, who was notified by the outside concierge and came in personally to deliver the message, took the initiative and asked: "Master, do you want me to go to Zhao Guogong's mansion first and ask?"
Normally, Zhang Shou would not refuse an appointment with his father-in-law, but the situation was different now. He always felt that these recent events were menacing, but not strange at all. After thinking about it, he finally nodded. The young man left quickly and came back quickly. After Zhang Shou finished another class in Jiuzhang Hall, Ah Liu appeared in front of him again.
"The Duke of Zhao is not at home. The eldest mistress told me that he sent someone to send a message home. He has important matters to deal with in the past two days and will not be back for the time being." When he said this, Ah Liu also had some doubts on his face. "I went to the Ministry of War Yamen again and asked. He said that after the morning court this morning, Duke Zhao entered the palace first, and then went to Lin Shangshu's house to express his condolences, and then left the city. He only sent a letter asking for leave."
"Then I went to the Lin Mansion again. Because there were many people paying their condolences, I sneaked in quietly. I heard people talking about Duke Zhao's visit, which is why so many people came with them. They are all people who follow the trend. Some people also said that Duke Zhao came by car instead of horseback today, and he brought many followers with him."
After saying this in one breath, Ah Liu saw Zhang Shou raising his thumb, as if praising his meticulousness, but he did not feel happy because of this, but became more solemn: "Then I went to inquire about the whereabouts of Zhao Guogong and his party, and someone saw that they did leave the city. However, after Zhao Guogong got in the car in front of the Lin Mansion, he stayed on the street for a while before leaving."
Although Zhang Shou was not very familiar with Zhu Jing, based on what Ah Liu said, he already felt that this was obviously very different from Zhu Jing's past style. Getting on the carriage but not leaving...could it be because there was someone else on the carriage?
Therefore, when he heard what Ah Liu said, he went to the palace to confirm that Zhu Jing had just left Qingning Palace and went to the Lin Mansion to express his condolences. Then he went to Zhao Guogong's Mansion for a second confirmation. He found out that Zhu Jing only brought eight followers when he went out today, and it was obvious that the eight people could not live up to what the servants of the Lin Mansion had said.
"You and I will go to the female school to meet Yingying. Something is fishy and I want to discuss it with her."
Because the women's school was occupied by women from top to bottom, although Zhang Shou came to pick up Zhu Ying a few times, he was always at the gate. At this time, he hurried over with Ah Liu and asked someone to announce the situation and then waited in front of the door. Unexpectedly, not long after, he met Princess Yongping coming out.
He and this Jinzhiyuye have known each other for a long time, but their personalities are not compatible, so they don't have much interaction. At this time, they just stepped aside and bowed. But Princess Yongping didn't just nod slightly in greeting like she did to ordinary officials. Instead, she stopped beside him and asked, "Are you here to pick up Supervisor Zhu?"
Although Zhu Ying often joked that she was the censor of the female school, in fact, the emperor originally had two seals carved. Princess Yongping was the superintendent of the school, and Zhu Ying was the supervisor of the school. However, Zhang Shou did not deliberately remember this name at all, so Princess Yongping used the three words "Zhu Jixue" to refer to Zhu Ying so seriously, and he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment before he realized it.
Immediately afterwards, Zhang Shou didn't care about such a title, but asked in a deep voice: "Why, Yingying isn't here either?"
When Princess Yongping saw Zhang Shou's short words, she actually showed a bit of anxiety. She couldn't help but wonder, and then she said: "The Queen Mother sent someone to see Yingying. Because he came suddenly and picked him up at the side door, the concierge at the main entrance didn't know about it, so he announced that he was going in. I happened to be back in the palace, so I told you, Bachelor Zhang."
"The Queen Mother again?" Zhang Shou subconsciously burst out these four words. He didn't care about Princess Yongping's subtle expression at this time. He immediately turned to Ah Liu and said, "Let's go to Nancheng Bingma Division first!"
Realizing that Zhang Shou actually planned to meet Zhu Tingfang, Princess Yongping suddenly realized that something might have happened. She originally wanted to ask, but seeing Zhang Shou and Ah Liu walking away very fast, she thought again and finally decided that instead of chasing after him to make trouble, it would be better to go back to the palace immediately and go to the Queen Mother of Qingning Palace to find out what happened.
One word after another, another word after another. Could it be that something happened again?
However, Zhang Shou had no hope of getting anything from Princess Yongping. Especially when he came to the Nancheng Army and Horses Division, he finally learned that Zhu Tingfang had been out for business about an hour or so ago. He had already been vaguely suspicious before and finally confirmed that his trip to Baiyun Temple was probably a must.
Because the appointment message at Baiyunguan sent by Ah Liu had not set a time, he did not leave the outer city immediately. Instead, he took Ah Liu back to Zhangyuan first. After taking a box, the master and servant left the west gate without stopping and headed west to Baiyunguan.
It was already dusk when Zhang Shou took Ah Liu to the girls' school. When they arrived at Baiyun Temple, it was already completely dark. Zhang Shou hurriedly stuffed two snacks into Zhang Yuan to satisfy his hunger, and drank a glass of water. At this time, Zhang Shou was not hungry, but the anger in his heart was quite intense.
At this time, Baiyun Temple was quiet, with its tall gate tower standing majestically, as if it were an ordinary Taoist temple outside. But when he heard Ah Liu's warning voice behind him, he knew that it was just an illusion. Because Ah Liu, whose ears are as sharp as his eyesight, is telling him softly where there are people hiding and where there are people watching, just like his other pair of eyes and ears.
Although this place was like a dragon's pond and a tiger's den, just waiting for people to fall into a trap, he still strode through the gatehouse and entered without hesitation. As a young Zhike Taoist appeared like a ghost, he bowed deeply and respectfully, and then asked in a deep voice: "Where is my father-in-law?"
Zhang Shou did not ask whether Zhu Ying and Zhu Tingfang were here, and the Taoist priest obviously had no intention of asking or answering. He didn't even say a word, he just bent down to salute again, then turned around and led the way.
